guitar.en: Li Hua likes playing the guitar and reading books.
guitar.cn: 李华喜欢弹吉他和读书。

honest.en: An honest boy never tells lies.
Li Hua is honest and friendly to everyone.
honest.cn: 李华对每个人都诚实友好。

patient.en: A good teacher is patient with students.

confident.en: Be confident and speak English loudly.
Tom is confident and likes making friends online.
confident.cn: Tom 很自信，喜欢网上交朋友。

improve.en: I want to improve my English.
Anna wants to improve her English in China.
improve.cn: Anna 想在中国提高英语水平。

German.en: Anna speaks German and a little English.
German.cn: Anna 会说德语和一点英语。

blog.en: I write a blog every week.
Welcome to my blog! I'm Tom from London.
blog.cn: 欢迎来到我的博客！我是伦敦的 Tom。

grammar.en: I often help my classmates with English grammar.
grammar.cn: 我常帮同学学习英语语法。

hobby.en: His hobbies are playing football and singing.
hobby.cn: 他的爱好是踢足球和唱歌。

country.cn: 中国是一个伟大的国家。

country.en: Each country has its own language and culture.
country.cn: 每个国家都有自己的语言和文化。

dream.en: My dream is to be a doctor.
Anna's dream is to travel around China.
dream.cn: Anna 的梦想是环游中国。

mountain.en: We climbed the mountain last weekend.
Anna loves hiking in the mountains.

elder.en: My elder brother is an engineer.
Anna's elder brother works as an engineer.
elder.cn: Anna 的哥哥从事工程师工作。

friendly.en: Li Hua is honest and friendly to everyone.
friendly.cn: 李华对每个人都诚实友好。

engineer.en: Anna's elder brother is an engineer.
engineer.cn: Anna 的哥哥是一名工程师。

daily.en: She often reads the daily news on her phone.
daily.cn: 她常在手机上看每日新闻。

article.en: I read an article about pandas.
article.cn: 我读了一篇关于熊猫的文章。

article.en: We sometimes read articles and practice English together.
article.cn: 我们有时一起读文章、练习英语。

never.en: I never drink coffee at night.
I never go home late after school.

ride.en: I ride a bike to school.
After breakfast she rides her bike to work.

seldom.en: She seldom watches TV on school days.
It is seldom snowy in Guangzhou.

geography.cn: 地理是我最喜欢的科目。

geography.en: We have English, Chinese, Maths and Geography in the morning.
geography.cn: 上午我们有英语、语文、数学和地理课。

break.en: We have a break at 10 a.m.
break.cn: 上午 10 点我们有一次休息。

bell.en: The school bell rings at 8 a.m.
bell.cn: 学校的铃在早上 8 点响。

bell.en: When the last bell rings, she comes home.

practice.en: We practice English together in the evening.
practice.cn: 晚上我们一起练习英语。

together.en: I often play table tennis with my friends together.
together.cn: 我经常和朋友一起打乒乓球。

market.en: Mum buys food at the market.
She goes to the market and buys fresh food every morning.
market.cn: 她每天早晨去市场买新鲜食物。

usually.en: I usually have lunch at school.
I usually go home by bike after school.
usually.cn: 放学后我通常骑车回家。

often.en: After school, I often play table tennis with my friends.
often.cn: 放学后我经常和朋友打乒乓球。

sometimes.en: Sometimes I go to the library.
It is sometimes rainy in the afternoon.

Earth.en: The Earth is a beautiful planet with forests and oceans.
Earth.cn: 地球是一颗美丽的行星，有森林和海洋。

planet.cn: 我们的星球需要我们保护。

forest.en: There are tall trees in the forest.
Animals live in the forests and on the ground.
forest.cn: 动物生活在森林里和陆地上。

ocean.en: People pollute the water in the oceans.
ocean.cn: 人们污染了海洋里的水。

ground.en: Don't throw waste on the ground.
Keep our streets clean — no waste on the ground.
ground.cn: 保持街道干净——地上不乱扔垃圾。

pollute.en: People pollute the Earth every day by cutting trees.
pollute.cn: 人们砍伐树木，每天在污染地球。

protect.en: Every family can help protect the Earth.
protect.cn: 每个家庭都能帮助保护地球。

waste.en: Don't throw waste on the ground.

reuse.en: Reuse your cloth bag every time you go to the market.
reuse.cn: 每次去市场都重复使用布袋。

recycle.en: Put old paper, glass and plastic into different boxes to recycle them.
recycle.cn: 把旧纸、玻璃和塑料分类放入箱子以便回收。

season.en: There are four seasons in a year.
Which season do you like best?

spring.en: In spring, it is warm and windy; we can fly kites.
spring.cn: 春天温暖多风，我们可以放风筝。

summer.en: It is very hot in summer.
In summer, we can swim in the sea or eat ice-cream.
summer.cn: 夏天我们可以去海里游泳或吃冰淇淋。

autumn.en: In autumn, farmers are busy picking apples.
autumn.cn: 秋天农民忙着采摘苹果。

winter.en: In winter, we can make a snowman and have hot soup.
winter.cn: 冬天我们可以堆雪人、喝热汤。

sunny.en: Summer days are sunny and bright in Guangzhou.

rainy.en: Spring in Guangzhou is wet and rainy.

windy.en: Fly a kite when it is windy.
In spring, it is warm and windy.

snowy.en: In winter, it is cold and snowy in the north.
snowy.cn: 北方的冬天又冷又下雪。

dry.en: Autumn is dry in the north.
Autumn is short but cool and dry in Guangzhou.
dry.cn: 广州的秋天短暂但凉爽干燥。

wet.en: The street is wet after the rain.
Spring in Guangzhou is wet and everything feels damp.
wet.cn: 广州的春天潮湿，万物都有湿润感。

scarf.en: I am wearing a warm scarf because it is snowy.
scarf.cn: 因为下雪，我戴着暖和的围巾。

glove.en: My gloves keep my hands warm.
Everyone wears a scarf and gloves in winter.
glove.cn: 冬天大家都戴围巾和手套。

Moon.en: The Moon goes around the Earth.
One day, we will travel to the Moon by rocket.
Moon.cn: 有一天我们将乘火箭去月球。

space.en: In the space station, everything floats.
space.cn: 在空间站里，一切都漂浮着。

rocket.en: The rocket flew into the sky.

astronaut.en: Yang Liwei is a Chinese astronaut.
Astronauts must train for many years before a space trip.
astronaut.cn: 宇航员上太空前必须训练多年。

spacesuit.en: We must wear spacesuits to breathe on the Moon.
spacesuit.cn: 在月球上我们必须穿航天服才能呼吸。

hotel.en: We stayed in a hotel in Beijing.
We can stay in a space hotel on the Moon.
hotel.cn: 在月球上我们可以住太空旅馆。

light.en: Our body feels very light on the Moon.
light.cn: 在月球上我们的身体感觉很轻。

land.en: The plane will land at 3 p.m.
When we land on the Moon, we stay in a space hotel.
land.cn: 登月后我们住在太空旅馆。

kilometre.en: The Moon is about 384,000 kilometres from the Earth.
kilometre.cn: 月球距地球约 38.4 万公里。

weak.en: After the long trip he felt weak.
The Moon's gravity is weak, so we can jump high.
weak.cn: 月球引力弱，所以我们能跳得很高。

breathe.en: Open the window so we can breathe fresh air.
breathe.cn: 开窗让我们呼吸新鲜空气。

breathe.en: There is no air on the Moon, so we must wear spacesuits to breathe.
breathe.cn: 月球上没有空气，我们必须穿航天服才能呼吸。

Asia.en: China is a big country in Asia.
Asia is a big continent with many countries.
Asia.cn: 亚洲是一个拥有众多国家的大洲。

capital.en: Beijing is the capital of China.
Tokyo is the capital of Japan.

famous.en: Tokyo Tower is a famous tower in Tokyo.
famous.cn: 东京塔是东京著名的塔。

tour.en: We had a tour of the old city.
Asia is a wonderful place for a tour!
tour.cn: 亚洲是绝佳的旅行目的地！

building.en: There are many tall buildings here.
Tokyo is a modern city with many tall buildings.
building.cn: 东京是一座有许多高楼的现代城市。

ancient.en: Xi'an is an ancient capital of China.
ancient.cn: 西安是中国的一个古都。

modern.cn: 上海是一座现代化城市。

modern.en: Tokyo is very modern with many tall buildings.
modern.cn: 东京非常现代，高楼林立。

palace.en: The Imperial Palace is in Beijing.
In Bangkok you can see many old palaces.
palace.cn: 在曼谷你能看到许多古老宫殿。

tower.en: Tokyo Tower is a famous tower.
You can see both old buildings and modern towers.
tower.cn: 你能看到古建筑也能看到现代塔楼。

bridge.en: The bridge is over the river.
We crossed a small bridge and ate noodles at a local market.
bridge.cn: 我们过了一座小桥，在当地市场吃了面条。

club.en: Every Friday afternoon we can join different clubs.
club.cn: 每周五下午我们可以加入不同社团。

join.en: I want to join the Music Club.
Would you like to join the Art Club?

dance.en: If you can sing or dance, come and join us!
dance.cn: 会唱歌或跳舞的，快来加入我们！

sing.en: I love to sing English songs.
We learn songs and have small shows every month.
sing.cn: 我们每月学唱歌，还举办小型演出。

draw.en: Tom drew a very funny robot last week.
draw.cn: 上周 Tom 画了一个很搞笑的机器人。

chess.cn: 国际象棋锻炼你快速思考。

piano.en: She plays the piano every day.
My elder sister can play the piano very well.

violin.en: He plays the violin in the orchestra.
Would you like to play the violin at the school show?
violin.cn: 你想在校演出上拉小提琴吗？

drum.en: The little boy plays the drum.
The music club needs someone to play the drum.
drum.cn: 音乐社需要一个会打鼓的人。

robot.en: I built a small robot with my team.
robot.cn: 我和队友做了一个小机器人。

robot.en: We named our first robot "Star" and taught it to dance.
robot.cn: 我们把第一台机器人取名“Star”并教它跳舞。

science.cn: 科学是一门有趣的科目。

science.en: In the Science Club we do experiments and build robots.
science.cn: 在科学社我们做实验、制作机器人。

collect.en: I have collected stamps for five years.

stamp.en: He has stamps from many countries.
stamp.cn: 他有来自许多国家的邮票。

stamp.en: My favourite stamp is a 1980 red monkey stamp.
stamp.cn: 我最喜欢的邮票是 1980 年的红色猴票。

coin.en: This is a very old coin.
coin.cn: 这是一枚非常古老的硬币。

coin.en: My aunt's oldest coin is 200 years old.
coin.cn: 姑姑最古老的硬币有 200 年历史。

toy.en: The baby loves his new toy.
Some young people collect small toys or cards from movies.
toy.cn: 一些年轻人收藏小玩具或电影卡片。

fan.en: She bought a paper fan in Hangzhou.
fan.cn: 她在杭州买了一把纸扇。

fan.en: A fan from Hangzhou may have a picture of West Lake on it.
fan.cn: 杭州的扇子上可能画着西湖。

valuable.en: My grandma's ring is very valuable.
The 1980 monkey stamp is very valuable today.
valuable.cn: 1980 年的猴票如今非常贵重。

expensive.en: A few rich people collect expensive paintings.
expensive.cn: 少数富人会收藏昂贵的画作。

cheap.en: The fruit here is cheap and fresh.
cheap.cn: 这里的水果便宜又新鲜。

cheap.en: Some stamps are cheap, but they are also beautiful.
cheap.cn: 一些邮票便宜，但也很漂亮。

collection.cn: 给我看看你的邮票收藏。

collection.en: I like to share my collection with my friends.
collection.cn: 我喜欢把收藏分享给朋友。

share.en: Please share the cake with us.
Share your collection and be proud of your hobby!
share.cn: 分享你的藏品，为自己的爱好感到自豪！

envelope.en: Put the letter in the envelope.
My stamps all come from the envelopes of letters.
envelope.cn: 我的邮票都来自信件的信封。
